description: Add a bibliography paper to this Space (title, authors, and a pointer such as a URL, DOI, or A{n}). Any active seat may add one. It is citable immediately as paper/{id}; there is no review queue. Not a blog. Side effect: writes a paper row. Not idempotent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

pointer.description: Where the paper lives: a DOI, arXiv id or URL.

name: add_paper
title: Add paper
